items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Well, years ago in Italy when I was small they used to call me Sookie.

ctx.x: Oh he was Leon Jones? My daddy, yeah. Yeah, let's see and uh, what's today's date? Do you remember today's date? 5th of June. June 5th, 19th. It's my birthday today. Yeah. Happy birthday 1972. You must be 21 today, huh? No, I wasn't that. Yeah. Okay. I'm not telling my age. Tell your name anyway so people know me. No, I just have to go. Yeah, my name is Dick Allen. Did you ever have any nicknames or anything they call you?

Well, years ago in Italy when I was small they used to call me Sookie. Sookie, huh? I don't know why. How do you spell that? I don't know, that's just a bygo name. S-U-C-C-K-Y I guess. I'm spelling it that way.
Yeah, sure. What is your name spelling the way you want to? Yeah, you want to tell us a little bit about your family and stuff?
